title: Pleat Strip
description: Alternating mountains and valleys on an 8-grid: the building block of tessellations.

steps.title: Quarters
steps.instruction: Fold both edges to the centre crease, unfold.
tips: Edges exactly on the centre line.

steps.title: Eighths
steps.instruction: Mountain-crease halfway between every pair of creases.
tips: Or turn over and valley-fold edges to the nearest crease.

steps.title: Pleat
steps.instruction: Collapse along the creases like an accordion.
tips: Work from one edge, one pleat at a time.
steps.check: A narrow stack of eight layers.
